thesis: The speakers argue that current AI models lack the ability for continual learning to build context and improve over time, which limits their economic value compared to humans who can interrogate failures and adapt to specific preferences. Consequently, the hosts suggest that while AI may automate white-collar work, it does not yet meet the definition of AGI because it cannot easily substitute for human labor in roles requiring long-term relationship building and personalized adaptation.
